network.stated_total_quote: The International Relations Department ensures the management and follow-up of more than 400 agreements with partner universities throughout the world. As it is strongly aware of the usefulness and importance of an educational stay abroad, it provides comprehensive support to research professors and students who undertake such an international experience.
